The '''Regional Government Offices''' located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was responsible for administration and legal affairs for the town. The building was used as a headquarters for the [[Imperial Prefect]], [[Orun Depp]], during his time overseeing the [[City/Legends|city]]. The Regional Government Offices maintained a record of all settlement deeds and census information.<ref name="TM" />

During the [[Escape from Tatooine|hunt]] for [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s visited the Government Office searching for information on settlements sold on Tatooine around the time of Tallon's disappearance.<ref name="TM" />
